The reference tests show the benchmark likely stresses normal listings, `-l`, `-T`, hidden-file filtering, sort modes, and disabled color/icon output.

To finish, I need exact Windows reference formatting for generated files, because the shipped Nix snapshots don’t directly match this runtime.
